name: Mubi

queries.query: Mubi Adamawa cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Adamawa State Geographic Information System (ADGIS) as the relevant state GIS and cadastral/land-information custodian. Its official service description says ADGIS produces digital land-parcel maps and provides cadastral, land-information, mapping, and survey services. The Adamawa State Ministry of Land and Survey is also an official land-record and land-survey service route. No anonymous public parcel viewer, downloadable parcel layer, or safe parcel-ID-plus-geometry endpoint was exposed.

queries.query: Mubi bayanan filaye taswirar kadastare hukuma
queries.result: The Hausa-language discovery route did not expose a first-party public parcel viewer or geometry service. Search context remained consistent with the official Adamawa state land/GIS custodians; no parcel geometry or citywide-absence claim is made.

researchNote: ADGIS and the Adamawa State Ministry of Land and Survey are first-party state custodians evidenced by official service pages. The packet records source discovery only; direct anonymous retrieval was blocked by Cloudflare and no public parcel schema, CRS, native identity, or geometry response was available. This is not source integration, runtime admission, or evidence of citywide parcel absence.
